_comment: Monthly TOTAL returns as decimals (0.0123 = +1.23%). Built by build-returns.mjs. Do not hand-edit.

sources.US: Ken French Data Library, Fama/French 3 Factors (Mkt-RF + RF)
sources.USSCV: Ken French Data Library, 6 Portfolios on Size and Book-to-Market, value weighted (SMALL HiBM)
sources.INTL: Ken French Data Library, Fama/French Developed ex US 3 Factors (Mkt-RF + RF)
sources.BOND: FRED GS10, repriced monthly as a rolling par 10-year Treasury
sources.CASH: Ken French Data Library, RF (one-month Treasury bill)

caveats: Emerging markets has no free long-history series, so EM is backtested as international.
International starts July 1990. Backtests that include it cannot begin earlier.
These are index returns with no fund fees, bid-ask spreads, or taxes subtracted.
